summary: Ten planning and browsing operations retire from the agent surface: domain active_work, observation record and dismiss, relate link, unlink, supersede, and restore_superseded, product_view portfolio, work_compact lesson_publish, and knowledge unprocessed. Relation writing keeps three scoped writers: resolve_overlap with version-pinned dependency, blocking, merger, and supersession, capture raised_from with the work item's creation, and the workflow link_successor forward_link. Operator decisions follow CD-0243 in conversation. Lessons publish through a reviewed pull request, the unprocessed negative is resolve_note knowledge_missing, and the Domain list, detail, and overlaps reads remain with observation rows readable. Relation kinds stay closed and relation changes write current rows.
title: Ten planning and browsing operations are retired from the agent surface
